result.instructions: Tools for Visualping, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our monitored pages changed in the last 7 days?"; "List all paused monitoring jobs."; "Create a daily job that watches https://example.com/pricing for price changes.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Visualping data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run visualping_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run visualping_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run visualping_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. visualping_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: visualping_describe_account
tools.title: Describe the account
tools.description: Describe the connected Visualping account: user id, organisation, plan and credit balances, and the workspaces with their ids. Call it first to find a workspace_id. Account API: GET /describe-user.

tools.name: visualping_list_jobs
tools.title: List monitoring jobs
tools.description: List the monitoring jobs (page monitors) in a workspace: URL, description, status, interval, last run and next run. Filter by status, monitor mode, labels, recent events or text. Jobs API: GET /v2/jobs.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit it to use the account's only workspace. Pass it when the account has several.

page_size.description: Jobs per page. The vendor default is 100.

status.description: Keep only active or paused jobs.

modes.description: Keep only jobs with these monitor modes.

event.description: Keep jobs with this event inside the time window in date_filter.

date_filter.description: Time window for event, a vendor value such as since_custom_date.

date_filter_start.description: Start date, ISO 8601. Needed with since_custom_date.

search.description: Search text in job URLs and descriptions.

tools.name: visualping_get_job
tools.title: Get a monitoring job
tools.description: Get one monitoring job with its settings, next run, and history. The changes list holds detected changes with an AI summary and the diff link. Jobs API: GET /v2/jobs/{jobId}.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit it to use the account's only workspace. Pass it when the account has several.

tools.name: visualping_list_labels
tools.title: List labels
tools.description: List the labels of the organisation. Labels group jobs; use their ids in list and create filters. Set compute_usage to count the jobs per label. Jobs API: GET /v2/jobs/labels.

organisation_id.description: Organisation id. Omit it to use the account's organisation.

compute_usage.description: true adds numOfJobsLabeled to each label.

tools.name: visualping_list_activity
tools.title: List recent checks
tools.description: List the activity feed of a workspace: recent check runs across all jobs, newest first, with job id, URL, and check time. Set include_errors to add failed checks. Jobs API: POST /v2/jobs/report-page.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit it to use the account's only workspace. Pass it when the account has several.

include_errors.description: true adds failed checks to the feed.

level.description: Feed level. The default "allChecks" returns every check.

tools.name: visualping_create_job
tools.title: Create a monitoring job
tools.description: Create a job that checks a page on an interval and reports changes. It starts active unless active is false. Jobs API: POST /v2/jobs.

url.description: Page address to monitor, starting with https://.

description.description: Label for the job, shown in Visualping and in alerts.

interval.description: Check frequency in minutes, as a string: "5", "15", "30", "60", "360", "720", "1440" (daily), "10080" (weekly).

xpath.description: XPath or CSS selector of the part of the page to watch.

important_definition.description: Plain words for the changes that matter, for example "price drops below 50 EUR". Used by the AI summary.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit it to use the account's only workspace. Pass it when the account has several.

tools.name: visualping_update_job
tools.title: Update a monitoring job
tools.description: Change a job. Send only the fields to change: set active to false to pause a job, true to resume it. Repeating the same change has no further effect. Jobs API: PUT /v2/jobs/{jobId}.

interval.description: Check frequency in minutes, as a string: "5", "15", "30", "60", "360", "720", "1440" (daily), "10080" (weekly).

active.description: false pauses the job, true resumes it.

important_definition.description: Plain words for the changes that matter, for example "price drops below 50 EUR". Used by the AI summary.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Omit it to use the account's only workspace. Pass it when the account has several.
